The shutdown is a direct result of Democrats prioritizing ACA subsidies and Medicaid expansions over fiscal sanity. While existing law bars illegal immigrants from federal healthcare, the reality is systemic abuse. Medicaid is collapsing under the weight of bureaucratic fraud AND unchecked usage by non-citizens exploiting loopholes—like emergency room mandates and state-level sanctuary policies.

The One Big Beautiful Bill rightly tightened eligibility, but Democrats want to reverse those reforms to prop up their bloated healthcare bureaucracy. This isn’t about “lying”—it’s about exposing how millions added to Medicaid rolls (through asylum claims, parole abuse, and state-funded programs) accelerate the program’s collapse.

Taxpayers shouldn’t foot the bill for healthcare systems strained by both illegal immigration and D.C.’s refusal to cut waste.
